dct_description_sm: The objectives of this study are: i) to establish the relationship between the composition of diatoms assemblages and current environmental conditions by using multivariate statistical analysis ; ii) to develop a transfer function to reconstruct historical concentrations of DOC and test its performance. The particular interest of this model is to allow, in combination with bio-optic models, to evaluate historic variability of the DOC concentrations and paleo-optical conditions in northern lakes.
dct_title_s: Limnological data and diatom distributions in northern Qubec lakes
